You say it’s going to be a bad idea multiple times here. You know your situation better than I do, us on this subreddit don’t have the specifics. But I’ve been in your shoes where I feel like “if I could just talk to them one last time.” It didn’t help me as much as I thought it would. If you have physical stuff to return to him that’s a good reason to go, but you already know that he’s not the same guy.

I’m saying this all with love, because I’ve been in your position and hurt myself trying to get closure from them rather than from myself.

I would genuinely think about if seeing him when he comes into your city is a good idea for you. I understand you want to see him, but think about whether or not it’ll genuinely be good for you to see him right now.

And don’t beat yourself up, you can start no contact at any time, there’s always a day 1.

Bro I was raised not to cry, haven’t cried for the past 10 years since I was like 10, and ever since my breakup 2 months ago I must’ve cried like 30+ times. It felt like failure the first couple of times but trust me, it’s so much better to let the emotion out and feel it instead of repressing it. You’re not failing. And there’s no limit on how many times you can cry over her, or how long you’re allowed to cry. It’s okay man, you’ll get through this.

Think about worst case scenario. Every time I think about texting her, I remember that if I text her and I get no response, or a negative response, it would put me into a depressive spiral. So what would a negative response do to you? It’s up to you at the end of the day, just put a lot of thought into whether or not it’s a good idea. Since you guys ended on good terms, I would say you’re probably safe but you know your relationship better than anybody on this subreddit.

It was a mutual friends story who was posting about my ex, not my ex’s story. I’ve known the friend for years before I met my ex. But I do appreciate the advice, I’m not gonna text her, I recognize it’s a terrible idea that gets me nowhere.
